question: Gaur Maria, a dance form of ___________ state, is a famous art form of joy and invocation. It is a group dance and both men and women participate enthusiastically in this dance.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gaur Maria** is a traditional dance form of the **Chhattisgarh** state.
 
• This dance is performed by the **Maria tribe** and is a part of their cultural heritage.
